summary: Slice 4: one canonical model-provider boundary with cancellation, timeout, health and prompt-secret refusal, plus the worker that consumes the journal

coordination.notes: Continues the same PR #285 branch and builds directly on the journal, broker, job store and scheduler from c6723e27. No active or blocked claims overlap. NO PRODUCTION MODEL IS SHIPPED: the only implementation in src/ is absentProvider, which never pretends to answer and is the honest default when nothing is installed - a deterministic scripted provider exists solely inside the test files, where it cannot be mistaken for a working model or imported by the app. The boundary is structural, not advisory: aiModelProvider.ts and aiWorker.ts import nothing from gameActions.ts, gameCommand.ts or gameLink.ts, so a model result has no path to the command boundary at all, and the worker's own test asserts that absence. Adds the first real consumer of the event journal, which the previous slice deliberately left unwired rather than shipping a producer with no reader. Qwen3 4B Instruct is carried as a reported profile string only; nothing in the interface is Qwen-specific and no cloud account is required.
